questions.title: Largest Asian Population Share
questions.prompt: Which US states have the largest Asian population share (alone or in combination)?
questions.disclaimer: Asian alone or in combination with one or more other races. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates (Table B02010)

questions.title: Largest Black or African American Population Share
questions.prompt: Which US states have the largest Black or African American population share?
questions.disclaimer: Black or African American alone; DC included per ACS reporting.

source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates (Table B02001)

questions.title: Highest Veteran Population Share
questions.prompt: Which US states have the highest share of veterans in the adult population?
questions.disclaimer: Civilian veterans as a share of the civilian population age 18 and over. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates (Table S2101)

questions.title: Highest Teen Birth Rate
questions.prompt: Which US states have the highest teen birth rate (ages 15-19)?
questions.disclaimer: Births per 1,000 females ages 15-19; DC included.

source.name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, National Vital Statistics Reports

questions.title: State GDP (Total)
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total Gross Domestic Product (nominal, 2023).
questions.disclaimer: Nominal (current-dollar) GDP by state, annual 2023, from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. Values in billions of dollars. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: GDP per Capita
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by GDP per capita (2023).
questions.disclaimer: Nominal GDP divided by resident population, 2023. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Unemployment Rate
questions.prompt: Rank US states by highest unemployment rate (annual average 2023).
questions.disclaimer: Seasonally adjusted annual average civilian unemployment rate, 2023. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: State-Local Tax Burden
questions.prompt: Rank US states by highest state-local tax burden as a share of state income (2022).
questions.disclaimer: State and local taxes paid by residents as a percentage of state income. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: State Sales Tax Rate
questions.prompt: Rank US states by highest state-level general sales tax rate (2024).
questions.disclaimer: Statewide sales tax rate only; excludes local add-ons. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: State Minimum Wage
questions.prompt: Rank US states (and DC) by highest state minimum wage (2024).
questions.disclaimer: Basic state minimum wage as of January 1, 2024; excludes local ordinances and tipped-worker rates. DC is included as a state-level jurisdiction.

source.name: U.S. Department of Labor / state statutes

questions.title: Fortune 500 HQs
questions.prompt: Rank US states by number of Fortune 500 company headquarters (2023 list).
questions.disclaimer: Count of Fortune 500 (2023) company headquarters by state. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Crude Oil Production
questions.prompt: Rank US states by crude oil production (2023).
questions.disclaimer: Annual field production of crude oil, thousands of barrels, 2023. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Coal Production
questions.prompt: Rank US states by coal production (2022).
questions.disclaimer: Total coal production in thousands of short tons, 2022. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Number of Farms
questions.prompt: Rank US states by total number of farms (2022 Census of Agriculture).
questions.disclaimer: Total farms per the 2022 Census of Agriculture. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Largest States by Total Area
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by total area (land + water) in square miles.
questions.disclaimer: Total area includes inland waters, coastal waters (within state jurisdiction), Great Lakes waters, and territorial waters — which is why Michigan (with huge Great Lakes waters) ranks higher on total than on land-only. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau, State Area Measurements and Internal Point Coordinates
source.asOf: 2010 Census reference (values remain the official Census figures used through 2024)

questions.title: Largest States by Land Area
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by land area only (excluding all water) in square miles.
questions.disclaimer: Michigan drops out of the top 15 when water is excluded (its total-area rank comes almost entirely from its ~40,000 sq mi of Great Lakes water). DC not included (source omits it).

source.name: US Census Bureau, State Area Measurements (land area only)
